resend_email_notes: Resend API key is configured in backend/.env. The send_payment_receipt() function is called from /api/payments/status/{session_id} (Stripe) and /api/payments/paypal/capture-order/{order_id} (PayPal) when payment_status='paid' and receipt_sent=False. The idempotent flag receipt_sent prevents duplicate emails. Since Resend sandbox only sends to verified addresses, actual email delivery cannot be tested, but the integration code path is verified.
